name: Sticks to Snakes
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level sorcerer/wizard 1, cleric/oracle 1, summoner 1, druid 1, magus 1, witch 1, antipaladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bundle of small sticks)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target bundle of sticks
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance none

DESCRIPTION

Upon throwing a pair of sticks and chanting the name of the spell, 1d6 sticks transform into snakes. This transformation is permanent. This increases by 1d6 snakes for every 2 caster levels past the first (maximum of 5d6).
